description:
List or remove a dependency on a task cancelled without delivery.

    ``escalation_id`` is a ``prerequisite_hold_stalled`` card. A waiting task
    whose dependency points at a task cancelled without proof of delivery can
    never start. Without ``task_id`` and ``predecessor_task_id`` this lists
    every such dependency in the card's project and changes nothing. With both,
    it removes that ONE dependency, so the waiting task can be groomed and
    built without the cancelled work; any other dependency is refused. The
    card then refreshes, or resolves when no held prerequisite remains.
name: remove_cancelled_dependency
title: Remove Cancelled Dependency
